articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Why The Narrative Around National Bank Of Greece (ATSE:ETE) Is Shifting With New Targets And Governance. National Bank of Greece has just seen a small uplift in its fair value estimate, with the figure moving from €14.33 to €14.46 per share, accompanied by a slight easing in the discount rate from 10.89% to 10.83%, while the revenue growth assumption of 4.53% stays unchanged. Together, these small tweaks point to analysts fine tuning their view of the bank rather than rewriting the story, which helps frame how they compare the current share price with the refreshed targets.
